newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma optimistic about second half of '97.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma optimistic about second half of '97.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said today it sees stronger results in the second half of the year, thanks to the development of new product lines, an expanding market presence in the Far East and Latin America and the completion of a major restructuring of its U.S. operations.

"We anticipate that both sales and earnings will accelerate during the second half of 1997, establishing a new profitable base upon which to build future growth," said Einar Sissener, chairman, in a statement accompanying the release of second quarter earnings.
The company also based its optimism for the last half of the year on a strengthened balance sheet.

During the second quarter, Alpharma said it completed a $180 million revolving bank credit facility and received more than $20 million from the sale of about 1.3 million new shares of Class B common stock.

The company reported earnings of $0.16 per share, or $3.5 million in the quarter ended June 30, versus a loss of $0.20 per share, or $4.5 million in the year-earlier period, which included $12.5 million in pre-tax restructuring charges.
Alpharma is a multinational pharmaceutical company that makes and sells specialty generic and proprietary human pharmaceutical and animal health products.
